desc: Establish the reduction from pair matching to assigning selected cakes to coordinate groups with each group having even cardinality, and prove conversion in both directions.
Fix parity handling and enforce even selected cardinality in every coordinate group.
Correctly derive and implement all parity-valid zero-, one-, and two-correction cases relative to the baseline odd groups.
Prove the bounded-modification claim rigorously, including ties, unused cakes, and all parity cases.
Add common-source corrections in addition to common-destination corrections, and verify whether any other modification pattern is required.
Replace potentially quadratic prefix-max slices in `special_two_sequence` with maintained prefix maxima; verify that the remaining top-two loops are constant-time.
Exhaustively validate the current implementation against brute force and confirm `O(N log N)` complexity.
